properties.description: Any additional information for the error.

PapCreateRequest.description: The body of the request - the policy to create (id will be auto-generated if not provided).

profile.description:
The profile(s) this policy conforms to.
IRIs identifying the ODRL Profile(s).

assigner.description:
The assigner of the policy.
Applies to all rules unless overridden at rule level.

assignee.description:
The assignee of the policy.
Applies to all rules unless overridden at rule level.

target.description: The target asset for the rule.

action.description: The action associated with the rule.

inheritFrom.description:
The parent policy(ies) this policy inherits from.
IRIs identifying the parent Policy(ies).

permission.description:
The permissions in the policy.
At least one of permission, prohibition, or obligation must be present.

prohibition.description:
The prohibitions in the policy.
At least one of permission, prohibition, or obligation must be present.

obligation.description:
The obligations in the policy.
At least one of permission, prohibition, or obligation must be present.

PnpContractNegotiationResponse.description: The state of the policy or an error.

PolicyNegotiation.description: Interface describing a rights management policy negotiation.

id.description: The primary id used by the provider.

correlationId.description: This is used by the other side of the negotiation.

policyId.description: The unique identifier for the policy.

dateCreated.description: The date and time when the negotiation was created.

expires.description: The expiration time for the policy negotiation if it's a manual process.

callbackAddress.description: The callback address to send updates to the requester.

publicOrigin.description:
The public origin of the server that initiated or received this negotiation.
Used to construct callback URLs in subsequent async messages.

organizationIdentity.description: Organization identity to be used when sending trust payloads.

code.description: A reason code for when the negotiation errors.

reason.description: A more detailed reason for the negotiation error.

description.description: A more detailed reason for the negotiation error.

handlerId.description: The id of the handler, on provider side this is the negotiator, on consumer side this is the requester.

interventionRequired.description: Is manual intervention required to complete the negotiation?

TrustVerificationInfo.description: Interface describing a trust verifier information.

identity.description: The identity associated with the payload.

data.description: Additional JSON-LD node objects associated with the verification.
